spindle.console.Replay.title: Replay
spindle.console.Replay.description: The body of `POST /api/dead-letters/replay`, a console route of a served run answered on the host's thread: the dead letter to run once more, by its component and its id, as `GET /api/dead-letters` lists it (`spindle.observe.DeadLetter`). No other member is read.

component.description: The component that keeps the dead letter.

id.description: Its id in that component's store.
